aphis:efile.name: AUTH - 0000030897 — Strawberry (J.R. Simplot Company)
aphis:efile.desc: Notification to release genetically engineered strawberry at 1 declared location in FL. Applicant: J.R. Simplot Company. Status: Acknowledged. Declared traits: marker gene, agronomic properties, product quality. The applicant claimed confidential business information on this record, so the trait description is partly withheld as [CBI] in the source. The dot is scattered inside the state, not placed at a site: APHIS publishes the state and the number of release locations, never the locations themselves. Australia is the only regulator in the world that publishes field trial sites. Position is a state centroid, not the site — APHIS publishes release states, never coordinates.
